Payment is slow, so checkout's calls to it time out

hypotheses.statement: Checkout sends payment more requests than users generate, because it retries failed calls
predictions: Failed checkouts contain several Charge spans
Payment request rate rises while checkout's stays flat

Payment traffic up about 5x while checkout traffic is flat (E1)
Checkout logs report the charge failing after 6 attempts

hypotheses.statement: Release otel-demo revision 7 changed how checkout calls payment
predictions: The release diff changes checkout's payment timeout or retry settings

stances.note: Revision 7 cut PAYMENT_TIMEOUT from 2s to 40ms and raised retries from 0 to 5
Six attempts per order matches five retries
Failures are deadline-exceeded, consistent with the shortened timeout
Checkout error rate jumps only after the 10:05 release

conclusion.summary: Release otel-demo revision 7 (10:05) cut checkout's payment timeout from 2s to 40ms and enabled five immediate retries (E13). Payment's slowest calls already ran past 40ms, so the tail of every order's Charge attempts began timing out and retrying, up to six attempts each (E12, E15), multiplying payment traffic about fivefold (E14). Payment slows under the extra load, more calls time out, and checkout errors rise from the moment of the release (E16). Autoscaling and node memory pressure followed (E11).
open_questions: Was the timeout change intended, and what value was meant?
Did the evicted pods affect other services?
proposed_actions: Roll back otel-demo to revision 6 (requires approval)
Add backoff and a retry budget to checkout's payment client
